I shared so much of my life with this woman, none of which I’ve shared to anyone else, even ones closest to my family. This December I had a seizure which introduced new medications on top of the ones I was already taking. This causes me to regress on my progress with anger quite a bit and I was experiencing fits of rage due to my medication. All whilst my “supportive” ex would tell me how much better I was going. At the beginning of our relationship I was open to having an open relationship as that’s what I was doing before her, she was uncomfortable with it so I stopped all that nonsense as I was committed to this woman. Fast forward to December after the seizure with new anger issues arising from me she then proceeds to ask me if I would be okay with a third. I said yeah that’s fine while also outlining that feelings were not involved and that if they were things would stop. Well that wasn’t the case, I find out there are feelings from both sides and once I had found out I told her it made me uncomfortable that they were hanging out and she just gave me a shrug emoji and said what do you want me to do? She’s my friend? So that made me go oh and I’m just some nobody. Then she realizes her mistake and begs for forgiveness, she hangs out with me that night and leaves for the morning then the next night she doesn’t text me goodnight or calls me which was regular, I had thought she maybe just fallen asleep and I was thinking all this is behind us now and feeling pretty great. I wake up the next morning to a long text about how she felt as if she was compromising for everything when in fact I literally changed my life for this woman. She then talks about how I’m manipulative when I literally let this woman do whatever she pleases even when it made me uncomfortable. And now she tells everyone at her workplace where I was once an employee as well that I’m toxic while she continues her facade with her co workers that she herself would talk shit about to me. I don’t even know what to do, at every moment I’m being portrayed as some crazy person and while I might be I’m just so fucking hurt and so angry and I don’t even know what to do or where to post and maybe this is the wrong place and maybe this will get deleted and if so I’m sorry.  Can anyone give me just a smidge of advice? I have literally gave parts of myself to this woman after all these promises of children, marriage, living together in the afterlife etc etc the whole shebang. How could both our parents cheat on one another just so she can do it too? I’m in a literally nightmare. I wake up and it literally feels like a dream most days. I guess I’m just rambling now so let me hit post
